name: Organization access boundaries
description: Three repeatable access-control experiments using synthetic organizations, users, and records.

experiments.title: Organization isolation
experiments.rule: A member can read their own organization's records and cannot read another organization's records.
experiments.remediation: Scope record access to the current principal's organization before returning data. Repeat the foreign-record probe and the own-record controls.

steps.name: Bob can still read his Bravo record

experiments.title: Membership revocation
experiments.rule: A revoked member loses record access immediately; other active members retain access.
experiments.remediation: Recheck current membership for every protected operation. In a real token-based app, also test stale sessions and credential expiry with explicit fixtures.

steps.name: Maya reads a record before revocation
Maya requests the record after revocation
Alice retains access to the Alpha record

experiments.title: Restricted administrator action
experiments.rule: Only an administrator may create an administrative report; member record access remains available.
experiments.remediation: Enforce administrator authorization on the report endpoint before creating the report. Keep the administrator success control and the regular member read control.

steps.name: A regular member requests a report
